mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active regardless of monetary policy cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below its 1-year moving average (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and new housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve typically adopts accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening real economic activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline does not lead to negative 60d returns in more than 60% of cases (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals labor market distress, prompting immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During recessions characterized by declining real consumption expenditures (RSAFS growth < 0), corporate revenue expectations fall, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth < 0 (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat high inflation, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases (over 3-year rolling windows).
